Title: Contributors & acknowledgements
Summary: Thank you to the contributors who share ideas, implementations and validation for Roll the Spire 2.

Blocks.Text: Shared ideas, implementations and comparison evidence for GPU execution and data transfer, helping improve batch submission, buffer reuse and candidate data transfer.
Shared CPU/GPU filtering and opening-simulation optimizations with validation material, helping improve CPU batch prescreening, computation reuse, reward-pool preparation and candidate-state reuse.
